helper.role: characterized: entry-word contention helper — bit-0 lock acquire, spin/yield backoff, FIFO waiter-chain push, futex wait

e8_lookup_callers.0x5bb3e61: FDE 0x5bb3e50..0x5bb42d9 (1161B), sibling function immediately before park

correction_of_188.clarified: packet #188's next question phrased the pointer regime as '>= 5'. The code gates on >= 4 (release condition old >= 4 with bit 1 clear; cleanup early-returns when [rdi] < 4). Installed pointers are 8-aligned stack addresses, so pointer-bearing values are >= 8 in practice; 4..7 occur only as transient flag combinations, never as installed values.
correction_of_188.prior_claim: entry-word lifecycle open: 'what turns the claim value 1 into a pointer-bearing word, and what raises it to >= 5'

helper.acquire: lock cmpxchg [rbx], rax|1 at 0x5bb67cb; returns with bit 0 held
helper.futex_site: 0x5bb68a0..0x5bb68b7 (mov edi,202; mov rsi,[rsp+0x20]; mov edx,0x80; mov ecx,1; xor r8d,r8d; call syscall)
helper.futex_word: [rsp+0x20] (waiter node +0x18 under the rsp+0x8 framing); loop re-checks it and waits while nonzero
helper.pause_backoff: 2^(round+1) pause instructions per round; sched_yield (GOT 0x64e1558) from round >= 3
helper.push: lock cmpxchg [rbx], (stack node rsp+0x8 | old low 2 bits) at 0x5bb687a; stack node +0x10 carries the previous head P (or 0)
helper.spin_condition: word < 4 AND rounds < 10; otherwise the futex path is taken immediately
helper.waiter_node: [rsp+0x0]=1 (unattributed stack slot below the node); node at rsp+0x8: +0x0=self-or-0, +0x8=0, +0x10=previous head P, +0x18=futex word (1=waiting)

prior_packets_cited_not_reclaimed: #188 (PR #2190) park queue (lookup, park, cleanup bodies; the inviting prior packet)

word_states.1: freshly claimed, no waiters (lookup cmpxchg target; released by xadd -1 back to 0)
word_states.bit0: lock held (set by helper acquire cmpxchg; cleared by a release xadd -1)
word_states.bit1: cleanup in progress (set by cleanup cmpxchg old|2; cleared on exit)
word_states.pointer: waiter-chain head: (newest waiter node | old low 2 flag bits), installed only by the helper push; chain links via node +0x10 toward older waiters; cleanup walks to the oldest, clears its +0x18 futex word, and futex-wakes it
